component.name: WorkerTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "drain" m.last = 0 m.count = 0 m.inversions = 0 end sub
' Function observer: runs on the writer (render) thread, so nothing runs on the task thread mid-batch. sub onReq(event as object) v = event.getData() if v < m.last then m.inversions++ m.last = v m.count++ x = 0 for i = 1 to 50 x = x + i end for end sub
sub drain() m.port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") m.top.observeField("request", "onReq") m.top.observeField("request", m.port) m.top.ready = true portLast = 0 portCount = 0 portInv = 0 idle = 0 while idle < 20 msg = wait(100, m.port) if type(msg) = "roSGNodeEvent" idle = 0 v = msg.getData() if v < portLast then portInv++ portLast = v portCount++ else idle++ end if end while m.top.report = "observer: n=" + m.count.toStr() + " inversions=" + m.inversions.toStr() + " | port: n=" + portCount.toStr() + " inversions=" + portInv.toStr() + " | final field=" + m.top.request.toStr() end sub
